WITH MediaTypeAverages AS (
    SELECT
        mt.MediaTypeId,
        mt.Name AS MediaTypeName,
        AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS AverageBytesPerMillisecond
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
    GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
),
OverallAverage AS (
    SELECT AVG(AverageBytesPerMillisecond) AS AverageOfMediaTypeAverages
    FROM MediaTypeAverages
)
SELECT
    mta.MediaTypeName,
    mta.AverageBytesPerMillisecond,
    mta.AverageBytesPerMillisecond - oa.AverageOfMediaTypeAverages AS AboveOverallAverage
FROM MediaTypeAverages AS mta
CROSS JOIN OverallAverage AS oa
WHERE mta.AverageBytesPerMillisecond > oa.AverageOfMediaTypeAverages;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the simple, equally weighted average of the per-media-type averages, as stated; media types with no tracks passing the size filter are excluded.
